evidence.description: Workstation 10.0.1.77 initiated DRSUAPI RPC bind to Domain Controller with DS-Replication-Get-Changes privilege on SRV-FILE-01
High-volume RPC traffic exchange retrieving domain password hashes for KRBTGT account
Network packet payload matches known DCSync query pattern (DsGetNCChanges) (host: SRV-FILE-01)

findings.description: Non-domain controller workstation requested full domain replication changes via Directory Replication Service.
Replication request specifically extracted password hash for critical krbtgt account.

output.rationale: Technical evaluation of observed process execution and network activity indicates that unambiguous DCSync attack: non-DC system abusing directory replication to retrieve domain password hashes without touching DC disk.

recommended_actions.action: Immediately sever network connectivity for pivot host 10.0.1.77.
Reset KRBTGT account password twice across the Active Directory forest.

alert.title: Certutil Invoked to Retrieve Content from Raw Pastebin on WS-101 (ALT-79850)

evidence.description: certutil.exe executed with -urlcache -split -f to raw.pastebin.com/raw/7bXa1 on WS-101
certutil.exe fetched 12 KB payload from public paste service (host: WS-101)
Downloaded script run.ps1 written to C:\Temp

findings.description: Living-off-the-land utility certutil used to pull external script from public paste site.
Script file run.ps1 deposited into temporary directory.

output.rationale: Corroborating indicators across endpoint and perimeter data sources establish that use of certutil to bypass proxies and download code from public paste repositories is a high-confidence threat pattern.

recommended_actions.action: Quarantine file C:\Temp\run.ps1 and block pastebin download URL.

output.rationale: Timeline reconstruction: Systematic event progression indicates that patching AMSI memory is a dedicated defense evasion technique characteristic of post-exploitation toolkits.

recommended_actions.action: Terminate PowerShell PID on PC-001 and isolate host.
